_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for both the profile README (maxgfr/maxgfr) and the website projects page (maxgfr.github.io). Edit ONLY this file. The README generator reads it locally; the website generator fetches it from this repo via the GitHub API. Bilingual: category titles have title_fr/title_en; each description is { fr, en }. 'exclude' is applied everywhere; 'excludeFromSite' is additionally removed from the website only. Any owned public repo not listed appears under the fallback category using its GitHub description.

devkit.fr: Extension Chrome pour devs web : cache et données de site, inspection de page (JSON-LD, en-têtes, Web Vitals…), règles de requêtes et analyse IA avec ton propre modèle.
devkit.en: Chrome extension for web developers: cache & site data, page inspection (JSON-LD, headers, Web Vitals…), request rules and AI analysis with your own model.

scopelet.en: Rust CLI skill that filters evidence locally before it reaches the model (Codex, Claude Code).
